review_authority.review_lead: the lotus-platform review lead, working with the chatgpt-codex-connector inline review bot
review_authority.mergeable_meaning: an exact-head VERDICT: mergeable means every required context is green on the current head and every review thread on that head is resolved
review_authority.escalation: unresolved disagreements escalate to the repository owner, who is the sole accepted collaborator

contexts: PR Merge Gate / Platform Repo Contracts

documented_exceptions.reason: the repository has a single accepted collaborator; requiring a non-author approval would hard-lock main rather than strengthen it, and naming that collaborator in CODEOWNERS would record an independent-review control that does not exist
documented_exceptions.compensating_controls: three required green contexts, enforce_admins, strict up-to-date branches, required conversation resolution, and linear history apply to every merge including the administrator's; the PR merge gate runs the full 1270-test suite plus every platform validator
documented_exceptions.retires_when: a second accepted reviewer identity exists; then raise required_approving_review_count to 1, add CODEOWNERS, and update this policy in the same change
